io.milvus.bulkwriter

Class VolumeFileManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.VolumeFileManager

  • public class VolumeFileManager
extends Object
    Manages uploading local files or directories to a Zilliz cloud Volume.

    Handles applying for the volume, refreshing temporary credentials and the storage client, uploading files concurrently with retry, and reporting upload progress.
